author: Rusty McMurray / Soulshine; built by Claude at his direction
preserves: v1.1-v1.6 (v1.6 receipt f7346db0...a9be). world.py and v1_readers.py byte-identical to v1.
direction: Rusty, 2026-10-15: try the scout / home-keeping model on the choice decision. Some scout; home makers confirm; a housekeeper. From the village: one in three scouts; nothing goes on the family map without a witness.
family: OPERATIONALIZATION BY CLAUDE, flagged. Three members read the same owner terrain (the family ground) at the same needs (need definition unchanged).

roles.SCOUT: reads the FRONTIER only: the newest 14 days (d-13..d) across the whole terrain, against each region's history before the 42-day span (days < d-41). Discovery = regional sign test p < 0.01 over eligible regions AND pooled frontier z > 2.326. Reports its up-regions. A scout never vouches for its own find.
roles.HOMEMAKER: confirms a scout's report on ESTABLISHED ground the scout did not read: days d-41..d-14, same baseline. Confirmed iff, among the scout's up-regions that are eligible, the established-ground excess is positive in a share passing the sign test p < 0.01, AND pooled established-ground z > 2.326.
roles.HOUSEKEEPER: keeps the family record of scout reports: confirmed find +1, unconfirmed find -1; needs with no discovery deposit nothing. Record never deleted; only entries within the present 42-day span weigh (v1.5 rule). The family PROPOSES when the present tally > 0.

ablation_SCOUT_ALONE: every discovery deposits +1 with no homemaker confirmation (the scout vouches for itself).
experiments: lambda 32, 128, 8 x 6 families x 300 seeds; probe; BURST b = 5, 8; v1.6 and v1.2 alongside on identical worlds.

predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.X3_positional_confounds: COMMUTE <= 5 and DINNER <= 5 at lambda 32 and 128.
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.X4_difficult_month: WINDOW <= 15 at lambda 32 and <= 30 at lambda 128.
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.X6_action: macro accuracy >= 0.8389 at lambda 32 (v1.6) and >= 0.8886 at lambda 128.
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.X7_information_limit: COLOCATED vs GENUINE |z| < 3 at lambda 32 and 128.
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.X8_cost: MAIN mean region evaluations <= v1.6's 287.6 (scouting reads one block; confirmation only on reports). Charged: R per scout read, R per confirmation.
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.X10_witness_matters: WINDOW proposals with the homemaker < SCOUT_ALONE's at lambda 32 and at lambda 128.

reporting_rule: PASS/FAIL as frozen with exact counts; discoveries and confirmations reported per family. No change after the first full run.
